description: Digimarket helps verified businesses find and list excess industrial inventory. Search by OEM part number, brand, category, quantity, unit, and price for cable, terminal blocks, ferrules, connectors, breakers, contactors, sensors, and related materials. Sellers prepare Excel-based listings in Talos; buyers discover available stock and contact sellers. Business verification is required for marketplace actions.
